weather_report:
As evening settles over Boston, a cool stillness envelops the city, casting a serene ambiance under a clear night sky. With temperatures dipping to a brisk low of around 39 degrees, the gentle west wind whispers through the streets, providing a refreshing touch of autumn. Bundle up in a warm jacket to embrace the chill, perhaps paired with a soft scarf to ward off any lingering dampness in the air.

Looking ahead to tomorrow, the sun promises to break free of any cloud cover, heralding a bright and animated day with a projected high near 65. The southwest wind, mild yet playful, invites people outdoors, making it an ideal time for leisurely strolls along the Charles River or a visit to the quaint café that has long been the heart of the neighborhood. With gusts flaring up to 24 mph, a well-fitted jacket will still be your ally, but as the sun’s warmth grows, you may relish the chance to shed a layer or two. It’s a moment to savor the palette of autumn, perhaps while sipping a seasonal brew as the world outside dances with anticipation of these perfect October days.
